content.text: This issue should be resolved when
is fixed.
Just a follow up incase this helps, I do see a fix is pending.  Reproducible docker-compose setup:

version: '3'

services:
  proxy:
    image: mikesplain/nginx-proxy-pass
    environment:
      - TARGET_SERVER=fcrepo:8080
    ports:
      - 3000:80

  fcrepo:
    image: fcrepo/fcrepo:6.2.0
    ports:
      - 8080:8080
Access via
http://localhost:3000/fcrepo/rest
THEN access via
http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
reproduces error for me.  If you
docker compose down
and access 8080 THEN 3000, you should be able to see issue as well.
I am no longer able to replicate this issue using your provided docker-compose config
Are you in a position to confirm that the fix has worked for you ?

$ curl -u "fedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin" -v http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
*   Trying 127.0.0.1:8080...
* Connected to localhost (127.0.0.1) port 8080 (#0)
* Server auth using Basic with user 'fedoraAdmin'
> GET /fcrepo/rest HTTP/1.1
> Host: localhost:8080
> Authorization: Basic ZmVkb3JhQWRtaW46ZmVkb3JhQWRtaW4=
> User-Agent: curl/7.84.0
> Accept: */*
>
* Mark bundle as not supporting multiuse
< HTTP/1.1 200

$ curl -u "fedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin" -v http://localhost:3000/fcrepo/rest
*   Trying 127.0.0.1:3000...
* Connected to localhost (127.0.0.1) port 3000 (#0)
* Server auth using Basic with user 'fedoraAdmin'
> GET /fcrepo/rest HTTP/1.1
> Host: localhost:3000
> Authorization: Basic ZmVkb3JhQWRtaW46ZmVkb3JhQWRtaW4=
> User-Agent: curl/7.84.0
> Accept: */*
>
* Mark bundle as not supporting multiuse
< HTTP/1.1 200
Attempting to access the Web UI and receiving
HTTP Status 500 -- Internal Server Error
from Tomcat.
